text: The order of work matters. The criterion was written and hash-sealed before the evidence harvest. It admitted dynamical pulsar timing masses, required an uncontested double neutron star system, and fixed the credibility standards in advance. Measurements outside that class were not used to win the verdict. A source caveat about a small extra shift from stellar evolution was found after sealing, so the rule was not narrowed. Even on the most source-generous reading, 19.3% cannot be absorbed into a small correction around 4%. The verdict stays the same.
